facts.fact: Development Gateway and IREX report that NEMIS supports the digital registration of learners, with data collected at schools, primarily by teachers, on Google Sheets and submitted electronically, and that interviewees used it to register learners, transfer them between schools and register them for national examinations; no attendance or results entry is described, and no date is given beyond the research period (December 2022 to February 2024), so the publication date is used.

The white paper states that NEMIS's modules capture learners, institutions, finances and teachers for all basic education institutions, primary and secondary; no date is given, so the publication date is used.

A 2021 Treasury education sector report, as cited by the white paper, found that only 65 per cent of primary schools had captured data in NEMIS, against a 90 per cent implementation rate in secondary education; no counts are given.

The white paper states that the Government of Kenya invested heavily in NEMIS, launched in 2017 with assistance from the Global Partnership for Education, and that a stakeholder called it meant for the Ministry and not for the school; the publication date is used.

The white paper states that the government had recently launched a re-engineering of NEMIS, to be renamed KEMIS with a wider scope and a unique identifier for each child from birth, on the recommendation of the Presidential Working Party's 2023 report; no date is given, so the publication date is used.

systems.platform: NEMIS portal; school data collected on Google Sheets and submitted electronically
systems.owner: Ministry of Education; launched 2017 with Global Partnership for Education assistance
systems.tiers: all basic education institutions, primary and secondary; entered at schools, primarily by teachers, sometimes manually where connectivity is limited; used at county level for teacher posting and capitation
recommended new name for the re-engineered NEMIS, widened to tertiary and vocational institutions and out-of-school learners
national; not published regularly, the last in 2020
